scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

scriptsInfo.dev:resume: Start the local session backend on port 3001 while preserving existing expeditions, players, and Fire TV assignments across restarts. Run before launching the Fire TV app. Does not use AWS.
scriptsInfo.dev:fresh: Delete the designated local SQLite expedition database and start a clean session backend on port 3001. Run before launching the Fire TV app when a fresh expedition is needed. Does not use AWS.
scriptsInfo.fire-tv:dev: Build, install, and launch Threshold on a named Fire TV. Run without arguments for an interactive device selector, or pass monitor, bedroom, or guest.
scriptsInfo.fire-tv:deploy:all: Build once and install Threshold on every connected authorized ADB device.
scriptsInfo.fire-tv:launch:all: Launch Threshold on every connected authorized ADB device without rebuilding.
